name: KNSC-Rcut
objective: min_{H,F >= 0} alpha * ||Phi(X) - Phi(X) F H||_F^2 + mu * ||H H' - I||_F^2

derivation.kernel_trick: W is restricted to the column space of Phi(X), W = Phi(X) F, so every quadratic term reduces to K = Phi'(X) Phi(X) and the feature map never appears explicitly.
derivation.lagrangian: L = alpha Tr[Phi Phi'] - 2 alpha Tr[Phi F H Phi'] + alpha Tr[Phi F H H' F' Phi'] + mu ||H H' - I||_F^2

gradients.H: dL/dH = -2 alpha F'K + 2 alpha F'KFH + 4 mu H(H'H - I)
gradients.F: dL/dF = -2 alpha K H' + 2 alpha K F H H'

derivation.kkt: psi_ij H_ij = 0 and xi_jl F_jl = 0 for the non-negativity multipliers; separating the positive and negative parts of each gradient gives the multiplicative rules.

rules.H: H <- H .* (alpha F'K + 2 mu H) ./ (alpha F'KFH + 2 mu HH'H)
rules.F: F <- F .* (K H') ./ (K F H H')

derivation.convergence: Monotonic decrease is proved with an auxiliary function.

also_available: champion/algorithm.py also defines update_ncut and objective_ncut, the normalized-cut form, which differs only by the scaling D^(-1/2). UPDATE and OBJECTIVE bind to the ratio-cut form.
